I checked both pages' DOM only. I did not do a full keyboard walkthrough, a visual focus check or a flash analysis, so criteria that depend on those are NEEDS_REVIEW.

**What I found**
- Both pages share one template. It has a header, `nav` landmarks, a `main` landmark and a search form. The search field has an `aria-label` and placeholder text, and a submit button.
- There is no skip link, but the landmarks and headings give a way to bypass blocks.
- Neither page has autoplaying media.
- https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/14194/ has two `<video controls>` elements, which I did not play.
- https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5340/ embeds an interactive tool in an iframe titled "Climate Legacies". I did not test the tool's contents.

**Decisions that need explaining**
- **Form criteria (1.3.1, 2.4.6, 3.3.2, 4.1.2):** I passed these because the search field has an accessible name that matches its placeholder. There is no visible label, only the placeholder and a search button.
- **Error criteria (3.3.1, 3.3.3, 3.3.4):** I marked these DNA. The only form is a search, which has no validation and no legal or financial effect. The iframe tool on 5340 may have its own forms, so 3.3.1–3.3.4 and 3.2.2 on that page are NEEDS_REVIEW.
- **2.4.1 Bypass Blocks:** I passed this on the landmarks alone. A person may want to confirm that.
- **5340 criteria needing review:** 2.1.1, 2.1.2, 2.2.2, 2.3.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7 and 3.2.1 depend on the iframe content, which I did not test.
